steps.content: On a street in Eastside, preparations for [Election Focus] are underway. The host finishes framing herself up and starts the show.
[Program Intro]

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Breaking news! Last night, a massive explosion rocked the city hall at 105th Street in District 3 of Eastside. It's said that multiple cabinet officials were killed in the blast!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: And here's the most shocking part of all: Prime Minister Stewart, who was presiding over the meeting, has passed away after being rushed to the hospital!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Though officials claim it was just an accident, unlike the West District explosion that could be easily brushed aside, this blast happened right in the council hall itself!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Now, let's go live with our special guest, Miss Pine, to hear her takes on this incident.
[Standard Program Transition]

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Hello, Miss Pine, thanks for joining us on [Election Focus]. I'm sure you're up to speed on the cabinet explosion. We were just discussing Prime Minister Stewart a few days back.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Heh, some class, finally, unlike the amateur hour over in the West District.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Do you have anything to say about his death?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Well... While I do regret his death, perhaps this "timely exit" will actually cement his legacy? Let's face it, his track record while breathing wasn't exactly stellar.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: jojo

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Honestly, Stewart's rise to power wasn't easy. For someone from an old second-rate elite family to claw his way to the top... that must've taken some serious effort.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Apart from those "minor blemishes" like the West District, Nirvana, the Rust, and Sinner management, he was a real workhorse, quite the model of integrity among all the political lapdogs. That should've made the puppet masters behind him pretty happy.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: By integrity you mean... he wasn't all that corrupt?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Take the Eastside District 5 reconstruction bill from a few years back—his peak as a councilor. With a modest budget, he aided Nirvana in building factories, helped real estate groups renovate residential areas, and ultimately even secured loans.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: From just this one bill, everyone got their slice of the pie—except for the District 5 residents, who were all swept out from their homes. And Councilor Stewart? Oh, not a dime lined his pockets, just a smooth ascension to the throne. What a beacon of integrity.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Oh, now things are heating up! Care to spill the beans on the explosion? You must be sitting on a goldmine of information about it!
As the revelations unfold, viewer comments flood the screen at an escalating pace. When it comes to fallen officials, Eastsiders never miss a chance to twist the knife.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Well, the explosion...
Through the connection, a clear tapping sound can be heard as Pine drums her fingers on the table, muttering to herself with a hint of excitement.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Everyone thinks this was a black op... but even you folks know that Stewart was already wobbling on thin ice, with slim chances of re-election. His rivals had little incentive to push things to this extreme.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Moreover, the evidence on-site points to the involvement of mysterious monsters in the blast. They are absolutely not the sort of creatures that any politician could control.
Pine shares several photos. Though grainy and poorly lit, they unmistakably reveal the architectural style of the City Hall.
Strange runes are discernible in the images, hinting at something far more sinister than meets the eye.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Monsters? Ah, I think I've caught wind of that. They say the West District has been dealing with monsters for a while, and now they're showing up in Eastside too because of the dark web.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: The dark web incident was orchestrated by the same group. They used to only operate in the West District, but now they've set their foot in Eastside...

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: But wait... I heard that the dark web got the axe already, and the crisis in West District was taken care of as well.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Appeasing a crisis without addressing the root cause only breeds a bigger one. It has happened with the dark web, and the two explosions this time follow the same pattern...

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Then, what is this root cause?
While the host leans in with piqued curiosity, Pine's expression grows grave, each word measured and deliberate.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: It's more secretive than the dark web, more dangerous than the Sinners, older than known history, closer to power than the city council itself—something nurtured in the shadows of this city—

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Ahhhhh!!! Monsters—!!!
